## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 4-fascicle text by [支婁迦讖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E5%A9%81%E8%BF%A6%E8%AE%96) Lokakṣema is one of the earliest Chinese versions of the *Sukhāvatī-vyūha-sūtra* — antedating the canonical *[Wú liàng shòu jīng T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060)* by roughly 70 years. The early-Hàn date and Lokakṣema's archaic translation style make this version one of the most important witnesses to the early-Common-Era recension of the Pure Land sūtra tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [支婁迦讖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E5%A9%81%E8%BF%A6%E8%AE%96) Lokakṣema's late-Hàn translation activity (178 – 189 CE).

The Taishō text (T0361) is established on a particularly rich apparatus including the *Dūn* 敦 (Dūnhuáng) witness.
